nodes.norm_label: deploying the bots on oracle cloud always free

nodes.label: Gotcha: Oracle reclaims idle Always Free instances
nodes.norm_label: gotcha: oracle reclaims idle always free instances
nodes.rationale: Under 5% avg CPU over 24h gets reclaimed; burning ~8% of a core via keepalive is cheaper than disabling idle detection.

nodes.label: Three separate Alpaca paper accounts
nodes.rationale: Independent equity curves are required for a meaningful leaderboard; one tagged account makes curves non-independent.

nodes.label: Containers pinned to America/New_York
nodes.rationale: Every strategy reasons in Eastern time.

nodes.label: Backend Stack (TypeScript monorepo, Fastify, Postgres, BullMQ)
nodes.norm_label: backend stack (typescript monorepo, fastify, postgres, bullmq)
nodes.rationale: Provider-agnostic agent runtime without LangChain; ARF-owned workflow code controls state, schemas, retries, budgets and audit.

nodes.label: Pine-compatible Research Runner
nodes.rationale: Scalable engine for sweeps and stress tests because TradingView lacks a public batch Strategy Tester API.

nodes.label: TradingView Verification Runner
nodes.rationale: TradingView remains the final parity/acceptance environment; browser automation must not become the platform core.

nodes.label: ARF-OS (AI Research Hedge Fund Operating System)
nodes.norm_label: arf-os (ai research hedge fund operating system)
nodes.rationale: Designed as a research factory of independent specialist lanes, not one all-powerful trading agent, so no agent can rewrite hypotheses, tune on holdout data, or promote its own work.

nodes.label: Final Operating Rule
nodes.rationale: The job is not manufacturing profitable-looking backtests but asking whether a hypothesis is causal, implementable, reproducible, robust and credible after adversarial review.

nodes.label: Holdout contamination rule
nodes.rationale: Final holdout evaluated once per version, seen only by Validator and Judge; child versions created after are marked contaminated so forward evidence becomes required.

nodes.label: Ask All (the floor) routing
nodes.rationale: A routing step picks 1-3 agents per question; keyword match is the fallback if routing fails.

nodes.label: Strategy Approval Levels (RESEARCH_APPROVED..LIVE_APPROVED)
nodes.rationale: No model or agent can independently grant LIVE_APPROVED.

nodes.label: LIVE_CANDIDATE ceiling boundary
nodes.rationale: No agent can grant LIVE_APPROVED; highest in-app state is LIVE_CANDIDATE.

nodes.label: js/agents.js - Agents with typed JSON contracts
nodes.norm_label: js/agents.js - agents with typed json contracts

nodes.label: DezQuant (ARF-OS Research Platform)
nodes.rationale: Static site, no server or build step; data stays in browser.

nodes.label: DezQuant artifact entry page (artifact.html)
nodes.rationale: Generated by build-artifact.mjs from index.html with inlined CSS for Claude artifact publishing; do not edit by hand.

nodes.label: Frontend Specification (Command Centre, Backtest Lab, Committee Queue...)
nodes.norm_label: frontend specification (command centre, backtest lab, committee queue...)

nodes.label: Agent Practice Arena
nodes.rationale: Agents improve against blind benchmark tasks; prompt changes evolve under scoring.

nodes.label: Composite Evidence Score (spec 12.7)
nodes.rationale: Transparent 0-100 weighted score; hard failures override the score so leakage cannot pass by scoring well elsewhere.

nodes.label: Deploy Agent Desk to GitHub Pages workflow
nodes.norm_label: deploy agent desk to github pages workflow

nodes.label: Refresh built-in prices workflow
nodes.rationale: Claude app version of the platform cannot reach outside websites, so candles are committed into the repo; backup crons because GitHub delays/skips schedules.

nodes.label: Version platform assets (cache-busting step)
nodes.rationale: Stamps script/stylesheet URLs with the commit SHA so phones never mix a new page with cached old modules (Pages caches 10 minutes).

nodes.label: DezQuant Logo (app icon SVG)
nodes.description: 64x64 rounded-square app icon: dark navy radial-gradient background with a thin gold gradient inner border, a bold gold D letterform whose diagonal tail stroke turns it into a Q (DQ monogram), and a rising zig-zag price line ending in an up-right arrow drawn inside the bowl of the D.

nodes.label: DezQuant Brand
nodes.rationale: Name from the file and gradient ids (dqBg, dqAu); quant-trading identity for the arf-os-studio platform.

nodes.label: D/Q Monogram
nodes.rationale: A D-shaped path plus a short diagonal tail stroke at lower right reads as both D (Dez) and Q (Quant) in one glyph.

nodes.label: Gold-on-Navy Palette
nodes.rationale: Navy radial gradient (#1d3047 to #070c14) with gold linear gradient (#fbe8a6, #e2b65a, #a8762a) conveys a premium, finance-oriented look.

nodes.label: Rising Price Chart Motif
nodes.rationale: Zig-zag upward line with an arrowhead signals market gains / trading performance.

nodes.label: Rating-to-action map (Buy/Overweight/Hold/Underweight/Sell)
nodes.rationale: Model never flips side and never sizes the trade.

nodes.label: Strategies one level under trading-desk/ importing ../core
nodes.norm_label: strategies one level under trading-desk/ importing ../core
nodes.rationale: Strategies import core/ as ../core, so they must sit one level deep.

nodes.label: Hypothetical results (backtest and paper)
nodes.rationale: Backtests benefit from hindsight; paper fills are simulated and not proof of a real fill.

nodes.label: Three arms, out-of-sample split, t-stat, costs vs gross
nodes.norm_label: three arms, out-of-sample split, t-stat, costs vs gross
nodes.rationale: Kit built to make failing strategies visible; a negative result means stop, not re-tune.

nodes.label: Same-bar trail assumption is fiction
nodes.rationale: Daily high/low order is unknown; assuming high first turns 53% win rate into 93%; audit rejects 373/381 trades.

nodes.label: Verdict: no demonstrated edge 2025+ (t=0.74)
nodes.rationale: Edge old and fading, gates add nothing, friction not the issue; do not trade or tune.

nodes.label: Compare ta against gated, not rules
nodes.norm_label: compare ta against gated, not rules
nodes.rationale: Any filter raises win rate; question is whether TA beats the strategy's two if-statements.

nodes.label: Model may remember the answer (training-data lookahead)
nodes.norm_label: model may remember the answer (training-data lookahead)
nodes.rationale: Ticker/date not hidden, so a good historical ta result is an upper bound; only post-cutoff paper trading is real evidence.
